data.description: Precisely find duplicate files based on content hash and safely clean up without accidental deletion
data.descriptionEn: Precisely find duplicate files based on content hash and safely clean up without accidental deletion
data.descriptionZh: 基于内容哈希精准找出重复文件，安全清理不误删
data.readme:
· Find duplicate files and suggest which copy to keep.
· Duplicates can be judged by file name or exact content match
· Require confirmation before deletion; moves to recycle bin by default
